units.source_text: 架空线依然绽放出耀眼的火光。

en.t: The overhead wire still burst into dazzling sparks.

units.source_text: 他回顾人生，并没有什么特别珍贵东西。

en.t: Looking back over his life, he found nothing especially precious.

units.source_text: 唯有这紫色的火光——只有这恐怖的空中的火光，即使要用生命来换取，他也想把它留住。

en.t: Only this purple flare, only this terrifying fire in the air, was something he wanted to hold on to, even if it cost him his life.
